01, 02, 03, 05, 06 pass; 04 NEEDS-WORK. Strong silhouettes (towers, crenellated gatehouse, onion dome) and good military detail (dummies, targets, racks). Fix: sun filling the banner width on a cream field in dark ochre for value contrast, plus a sun flag or sun finial on the dome. Notes: 03 oak flag reads as a lozenge at 144 studs (acceptable nearer 80); gold onion dome is a teardrop silhouette, top it with a sun finial so it cannot read as the retired flame; crowns plain cream here vs gold elsewhere; strip at 144 studs has buildings abutting. Tris 8734-11698 of 12000 (03 at 97.5%).

The oak leaf is ivory with a midrib and stem, the best oak rendition in the kit. All four share the same twin-tower + arch base, so variation comes from the tops only (acceptable for one per kingdom). Minor: the flag is visible only on the blue variant at gameplay distance (the yellow flag hides behind its merlons in the hero shot). Tris 7558-8470/9000.

Weakness: the ram log barely protrudes past the front frame, and on blue/green/yellow the head reads as a grey boulder inside a shed, so the object reads as a covered wagon or hut on wheels before it reads as a ram. Extend the log 2-3 studs beyond the frame with a shaped iron head like red_01. green_01 is 3808/4000 (95%) of budget.
